name: Data integrity
rule: >=1 reading per market, all with a source URL and a UTC stamp

name: Sample sufficiency
rule: n >= 100 settled bets per market type

name: Out-of-sample
rule: graded on events never used to fit the model

name: Probability quality
rule: Brier score better than the market's Brier score
observed: not computed: needs a per-market probability with n>=30

name: Significance
rule: one-sided p < 0.05 on the skill score

name: Multiplicity
observed: not computed: needs the full trial log

name: Stability
rule: no single week contributes more than 50% of the skill

name: Shadow period
rule: a further pre-registered segment with no gate regression
